requirement: File tool results the model reads are capped where the measured tail is: grep 100 matches and 1,000-byte previews, bash lines at 2,000 and outputs at 12,000 with the whole output kept in the session's spill file; read keeps dsh's own caps

oracle.ref: PR #1026 (feat); fix evidence: Harness profile 09/10/2026 (candidate 8): tool results carried to later steps are 27-29% of all prompt tokens. Simulated on 1,980 bench sessions (24/09-05/10/2026): bash 55 of 2,255 calls cut, 696k of 4.07M characters (17%); grep 54 of 434 calls, 255k characters (21.5%, 27% carried); read 14 of 565 calls, 43k characters (1.7%), dropped in review. bash and grep together: about 4.4% of all carried tool-result characters.
oracle.invariant: S2: every test named in run.tests reports ok. Both bundles' twelve presets set tool-fs-search grepMaxMatches 100 and grepMaxLineBytes 1000 (sampleOverCapGlobResults false kept), each a field dsh's tool still declares and lower than its default; no preset sets a read cap on tool-fs (readMaxLineLength, readMaxBytes, readLimit stay dsh's: a 1,000-character line cap was reverted in review because read cannot page inside a line, Writer and SEO/GEO have no shell to reach the rest, and a whole-file write rebuilt from a cut line would corrupt the file); no Tracy file overrides dsh-base's spill-policy (maxInlineTokens 12500). A bash output within 2,000 characters a line and 12,000 in all is untouched; a longer line keeps its start and its length; a longer output keeps its head and tail by whole lines and counts the rest; the exit/timeout markers stay last; the whole output is saved through the spill store under the session and call, and the notice names its file and how to print one part of a long line; with no store, a failing store or no session nothing is cut; other tools, program sub-calls, value replacements and image results pass untouched; the provider registers the bound on tools/post-execute. Every command exits 0.
